== Strategy ==

Strat 1: Deploy Characters and Hope to God they dont Die. Trooper CHarge is to give you that last bit of power. Blast Points can add a bit of extra power and attrition.

Strat 2: Abyssins. Hopefully, you can forfeit them to the used pile to rid yourself of battle damage. Incosequential Losses can help by fofeiting your Blaster Rifles.

Strat 3: Space Superiority. Use Tallon Roll to rid yourself of pesky starfighters (hopefully). Plus they add Nice 6's to the deck.

Strat 4: Trap People in the Desert. Thats what the dewbacks are for. (besides adding battle destinies).

Not maybe up to real tournament standards, but still fun nonethless in this scenario format. Everything is from the original trilogy, without using starting interrupts or starting effects, or Objectives, or practically for that matter, anything. Tell me what you think.
